warnings.message: uv: no exact version is pinned, so depcurfew configures for uv 0.13.6, the latest version it knows
warnings.fix: Pin the version you use (required-version in [tool.uv], .tool-versions or a CI setup step) to configure for it

warnings.message: uv has no setting for git dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile

warnings.message: uv has no setting for URL dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile

warnings.message: uv: uv.lock records exclude-newer, so it is out of date after this change
warnings.fix: Run uv lock and commit uv.lock; until then uv sync --locked and uv lock --check fail

warnings.message: PDM: no exact version is pinned, so depcurfew configures for PDM 2.29.5, the latest version it knows
warnings.fix: Use PDM 2.29.5 or a recent version wherever the project is installed; PDM has no setting that pins its version in the project

warnings.message: PDM: only-binary forbids building only packages from an index; PDM still builds git, local directory and source archive dependencies
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor to find them in the lockfile

warnings.message: PDM has no setting for git dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile

warnings.message: PDM has no setting for URL dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile

warnings.message: PDM: pdm.lock is checked against the whole [tool.pdm.resolution] table, and this change alters exclude-newer and only-binary, so pdm.lock is out of date
warnings.fix: Run pdm lock and commit pdm.lock; until then pdm lock --check and pdm install --check fail
